async def _stream_graph(
    context: RunContext,
    runtime: RunRuntime,
    graph,
    config: dict[str, Any],
    graph_input: Any,
    *,
    is_new_conversation: bool = False,
    resumed: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """执行图并持续发事件；挂起时落库部分内容并发 run.interrupted。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    publisher = context.publisher
    run_id = runtime.run_id
    started_at = runtime.started_at
    first_token_ms: int | None = runtime.first_token_ms
    content_parts = runtime.content_parts
    reasoning_parts = runtime.reasoning_parts
    reasoning_started: datetime | None = None
    usage = runtime.usage

    try:
        if resumed:
            await publisher.emit(
                "run.resumed",
                {
                    "run_id": str(run_id),
                    "conversation_id": str(runtime.conversation_id),
                    "status": "running",
                },
                event_type="run",
                title="继续运行",
            )
        else:
            if is_new_conversation:
                await publisher.emit(
                    "conversation.created",
                    {
                        "conversation_id": str(runtime.conversation_id),
                        "title": runtime.conversation_title,
                    },
                    event_type="message",
                    title="创建会话",
                )
            await publisher.emit(
                "run.started",
                {
                    "conversation_id": str(runtime.conversation_id),
                    "user_message_id": str(runtime.user_message_id),
                    "client_message_id": runtime.client_message_id,
                    "model": runtime.model_name,
                    "reasoning_effort": runtime.reasoning_effort,
                    "workflow_id": None,
                    "workflow_version": None,
                },
                event_type="request",
                title="用户请求",
                subtitle=runtime.user_text[:80],
            )
            await publisher.emit(
                "message.created",
                {
                    "message_id": str(runtime.user_message_id),
                    "role": "user",
                    "client_message_id": runtime.client_message_id,
                    "created_at": to_iso(runtime.user_message_created),
                },
                event_type="message",
                title="用户消息",
                subtitle=runtime.user_text[:80],
            )
            assistant_message_id = runtime.run.assistant_message_id
            await publisher.emit(
                "message.started",
                {
                    "message_id": str(assistant_message_id) if assistant_message_id else "",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "started_at": to_iso(_now()),
                },
                event_type="message",
                status="running",
                title="助手消息",
            )
            for notice in runtime.runner.notices:
                await publisher.emit(
                    "notice",
                    notice,
                    event_type="notice",
                    status="warning" if notice.get("level") == "warning" else "ok",
                    title=notice.get("code") or "提示",
                    subtitle=notice.get("message") or "",
                )

        async for chunk, metadata in graph.astream(
            graph_input,
            config,
            stream_mode="messages",
        ):
            if context.cancel_requested:
                raise asyncio.CancelledError  # noqa: TRY301 - 取消信号需要冒泡到外层
            if metadata.get("langgraph_node") != "model":
                continue
            if not hasattr(chunk, "content"):
                continue

            reasoning = chunk.additional_kwargs.get("reasoning_content")
            if isinstance(reasoning, str) and reasoning:
                if reasoning_started is None:
                    reasoning_started = _now()
                reasoning_parts.append(reasoning)
                await publisher.emit(
                    "reasoning.delta",
                    {"message_id": str(runtime.run.assistant_message_id), "delta": reasoning},
                    persist=False,
                )

            text = _content_text(chunk.content)
            if text:
                if first_token_ms is None:
                    first_token_ms = elapsed_ms(started_at)
                content_parts.append(text)
                await publisher.emit(
                    "message.delta",
                    {"message_id": str(runtime.run.assistant_message_id), "delta": text},
                    persist=False,
                )
            if chunk.usage_metadata:
                usage = (
                    _add_usage(runtime.usage, dict(chunk.usage_metadata))
                    if resumed
                    else dict(chunk.usage_metadata)
                )

        snapshot = await graph.aget_state(config)
        if snapshot.next:
            await _finalize_waiting_approval(context=context, runtime=runtime)
            return
        messages = snapshot.values.get("messages", [])
        if messages:
            final_message = messages[-1]
            final_text = _content_text(getattr(final_message, "content", ""))
            if final_text and not content_parts:
                content_parts.append(final_text)
            if getattr(final_message, "usage_metadata", None) and not usage:
                usage = dict(final_message.usage_metadata)

        now = _now()
        duration_ms = elapsed_ms(started_at, now)
        notes = _usage_dict(usage)
        content = "".join(content_parts)
        assistant_message_id = runtime.run.assistant_message_id

        if snapshot.values.get("halted"):
            await asyncio.shield(
                _finalize_canceled(
                    context=context,
                    content=content,
                    usage=notes,
                    first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                    started_at=started_at,
                    reason="approval_timeout",
                )
            )
            return

        if reasoning_parts:
            await publisher.emit(
                "reasoning.done",
                {
                    "message_id": str(assistant_message_id) if assistant_message_id else "",
                    "duration_ms": elapsed_ms(reasoning_started or started_at),
                    "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
                    "summary": "".join(reasoning_parts)[:2000],
                },
                event_type="message",
                title="思考摘要",
            )

        completed = await _finalize_success(
            run_id=run_id,
            assistant_message_id=assistant_message_id,
            content=content,
            usage=notes,
            first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            finished_at=now,
            citations=context.citations,
        )
        if not completed:
            await asyncio.shield(
                _finalize_canceled(
                    context=context,
                    content=content,
                    usage=notes,
                    first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                    started_at=started_at,
                )
            )
            return
        if context.terminal_emitted:
            return
        context.terminal_emitted = True
        await publisher.emit(
            "message.done",
            {
                "conversation_id": str(runtime.conversation_id),
                "message_id": str(assistant_message_id) if assistant_message_id else "",
                "usage": notes,
                "finish_reason": "stop",
                "model": runtime.model_name,
                "first_token_ms": first_token_ms,
                "duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "active_duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "citations": context.citations,
                "artifacts": [],
                "reasoning": (
                    {
                        "duration_ms": elapsed_ms(reasoning_started or started_at),
                        "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
                        "summary": "".join(reasoning_parts)[:2000],
                    }
                    if reasoning_parts
                    else None
                ),
            },
            event_type="message",
            title="助手回复",
            subtitle=content[:80],
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            tokens=notes,
        )
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        logger.info("运行被取消 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_canceled(
                context=context,
                content="".join(content_parts),
                usage=_usage_dict(usage),
                first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                started_at=started_at,
            )
        )
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("运行失败 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_failed(
                context=context,
                content="".join(content_parts),
                usage=_usage_dict(usage),
                first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                started_at=started_at,
            )
        )

    run_id = context.run_id

                async with get_session_factory()() as db:

async def halt_run(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    """清理 checkpoint 里残留的 interrupt；不写 run/message、不发事件。"""
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return False
        start_seq = await _event_start_seq(run_id)
        publisher = RunEventPublisher(run_id, get_session_factory(), bus, start_seq=start_seq)
        context = RunContext(run_id=run_id, publisher=publisher)
        runtime = await prepare_runtime(db, run, publisher, context, resumed=True)

    async with open_checkpointer() as saver:
        graph = _build_graph_for(runtime, saver, halt=True)
        config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(runtime.conversation_id)}}
        snapshot = await graph.aget_state(config)
        if not snapshot.next:
            return False
        async for _ in graph.astream(
            Command(resume={"decision": "cancel"}), config, stream_mode="messages"
        ):
            pass
    return True


async def _finalize_waiting_approval(
    *,
    context: RunContext,

    """图停在审批 gate：落库部分内容、run→interrupted、发非终态 run.interrupted。"""
    now = _now()
    duration_ms = elapsed_ms(runtime.started_at, now)
    content = "".join(runtime.content_parts)
    usage = _usage_dict(runtime.usage)

        run.status = "interrupted"
        run.duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.first_token_ms = runtime.first_token_ms

        conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)

    await context.publisher.emit(

    """首轮执行：装配运行时、构建图并驱动事件流。"""
    run_id = context.run_id
    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
            if run is None:
                return
            if run.status != "running":
                if run.status == "canceled" and not context.terminal_emitted:
                    context.terminal_emitted = True
                    conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
                    if conversation is not None:
                        conversation.message_count += 1
                        conversation.last_message_at = _now()
                        conversation.last_message_preview = "（已取消）"
                        await db.commit()
                    await context.publisher.emit(
                        "message.done",
                        {
                            "message_id": (
                                str(run.assistant_message_id) if run.assistant_message_id else ""
                            ),
                            "usage": _usage_dict(None),
                            "finish_reason": "canceled",
                            "model": run.model,
                            "first_token_ms": None,
                            "duration_ms": 0,

                            "citations": context.citations,
                            "artifacts": [],
                        },
                        event_type="message",
                        status="canceled",
                        title="已取消",
                    )
                return
            runtime = await prepare_runtime(db, run, context.publisher, context, resumed=False)

        async with open_checkpointer() as saver:
            graph = _build_graph_for(runtime, saver)
            config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(runtime.conversation_id)}}

            await _stream_graph(

async def schedule_resume(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    """调度审批恢复任务；返回是否成功调度（不等待图执行）。"""
    if registry.is_running(run_id):
        return False
    start_seq = await _event_start_seq(run_id)
    publisher = RunEventPublisher(run_id, get_session_factory(), bus, start_seq=start_seq)
    context = RunContext(run_id=run_id, publisher=publisher)
    registry.start(context, resume_after_decision(context))
    return True


async def resume_after_decision(context: RunContext) -> None:
    """审批决定后的后台恢复：抢占 interrupted→running 并续跑同一条 run。"""
    run_id = context.run_id
    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            updated = await db.execute(
                update(Run)
                .where(Run.id == run_id, Run.status == "interrupted")
                .values(status="running")
            )
            await db.commit()
            if not updated.rowcount:
                return
            run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
            if run is None:
                return
            runtime = await prepare_runtime(db, run, context.publisher, context, resumed=True)

        async with open_checkpointer() as saver:
            graph = _build_graph_for(runtime, saver)
            config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(runtime.conversation_id)}}
            snapshot = await graph.aget_state(config)
            if not snapshot.next:
                # 决定先于挂起：gate 已按 DB 状态继续，回滚抢占即可。
                async with get_session_factory()() as db:
                    await db.execute(
                        update(Run)
                        .where(Run.id == run_id, Run.status == "running")
                        .values(status="interrupted")
                    )
                    await db.commit()
                return
            await _stream_graph(
                context,
                runtime,
                graph,
                config,
                Command(resume={"decision": "resume"}),
                resumed=True,
            )
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        logger.info("恢复任务被取消 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_canceled(
                context=context,
                content="",
                usage=_usage_dict(None),
                first_token_ms=None,
                started_at=_now(),
            )
        )
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("恢复运行失败 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_failed(
                context=context,
                content="",
                usage=_usage_dict(None),
                first_token_ms=None,
                started_at=_now(),
            )
        )


async def halt_run(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    """清理 checkpoint 里残留的 interrupt；不写 run/message、不发事件。"""
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return False
        start_seq = await _event_start_seq(run_id)
        publisher = RunEventPublisher(run_id, get_session_factory(), bus, start_seq=start_seq)
        context = RunContext(run_id=run_id, publisher=publisher)
        runtime = await prepare_runtime(db, run, publisher, context, resumed=True)

    async with open_checkpointer() as saver:
        graph = _build_graph_for(runtime, saver, halt=True)
        config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(runtime.conversation_id)}}
        snapshot = await graph.aget_state(config)
        if not snapshot.next:
            return False
        async for _ in graph.astream(
            Command(resume={"decision": "cancel"}), config, stream_mode="messages"
        ):
            pass
    return True


async def _finalize_waiting_approval(
    *,
    context: RunContext,
    runtime: RunRuntime,
) -> None:
    """图停在审批 gate：落库部分内容、run→interrupted、发非终态 run.interrupted。"""
    now = _now()
    duration_ms = elapsed_ms(runtime.started_at, now)
    content = "".join(runtime.content_parts)
    usage = _usage_dict(runtime.usage)
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, runtime.run_id)
        if run is None:
            return
        assistant = (
            await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id) if run.assistant_message_id else None
        )
        if assistant is not None:

        run.status = "interrupted"

    user_message_id: uuid.UUID
    user_text: str
    client_message_id: str
    user_message_created: datetime
    reasoning_effort: str


def _add_usage(base: dict[str, Any], extra: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result = dict(base)
    for key in ("input_tokens", "output_tokens", "reasoning_tokens", "total_tokens"):
        if key in extra:
            result[key] = int(result.get(key) or 0) + int(extra.get(key) or 0)
    return result


async def _event_start_seq(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> int:
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        value = await db.scalar(select(func.max(RunEvent.seq)).where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id))
    return int(value or 0)


async def prepare_runtime(
    db,
    run: Run,
    publisher: RunEventPublisher,
    context: RunContext,
    *,
    resumed: bool,
) -> RunRuntime:
    """能力装配 + 工具目录 + 模型；恢复时从 DB 读回已产出内容/引用/usage。"""
    conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
    user_message = await db.get(Message, run.user_message_id) if run.user_message_id else None
    assistant_message = (
        await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id) if run.assistant_message_id else None
    )
    if conversation is None or user_message is None or assistant_message is None:
        _raise_missing_run_data()
    user = await db.get(User, conversation.user_id)
    if user is None:
        _raise_missing_run_data()
    run_capabilities = run.capabilities or {}

    assembled = await capabilities_module.assemble(
        db,
        user,
        attachment_ids=[uuid.UUID(item) for item in run_capabilities.get("attachments", [])],
        skill_ids=[uuid.UUID(item) for item in run_capabilities.get("skills", [])],
        mcp_server_ids=[uuid.UUID(item) for item in run_capabilities.get("mcp_servers", [])],
        mcp_tool_ids=[uuid.UUID(item) for item in run_capabilities.get("mcp_tools", [])],
    )
    if assembled.attachment_snapshot:
        user_message.attachments = assembled.attachment_snapshot
        await db.commit()

    runner = ToolRunner(
        run_id=run.id,
        publisher=publisher,
        user_id=user.id,
        user_role=user.role,
        mcp_tools=assembled.mcp_tool_map,
        active_skill_ids=assembled.active_skill_ids,
        a2a_agents=assembled.a2a_agent_map,
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        # 与 RunContext 共享同一个 list：工具追加，终态读取。
        citations=context.citations,
        knowledge_categories=[
            str(item) for item in run_capabilities.get("knowledge_categories", [])
        ],
    )
    tools = [
        *build_native_tools(runner),
        build_search_knowledge_tool(runner),
        *build_mcp_tools(runner, assembled.mcp_tool_map),
    ]
    send_message_tool = build_send_message_tool(runner, assembled.a2a_agent_map)
    if send_message_tool is not None:
        tools.append(send_message_tool)

    content_parts: list[str] = []
    reasoning_parts: list[str] = []
    usage: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if resumed:
        if assistant_message.content:
            content_parts.append(assistant_message.content)
        if assistant_message.citations:
            context.citations.extend(assistant_message.citations)
        usage = {
            "input_tokens": run.input_tokens,
            "output_tokens": run.output_tokens,
            "reasoning_tokens": run.reasoning_tokens,
            "total_tokens": run.input_tokens + run.output_tokens,
        }

    model_input = user_message.content
    if assembled.attachment_text:
        model_input = f"{user_message.content}\n\n{assembled.attachment_text}"

    return RunRuntime(
        run_id=run.id,
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        conversation_title=conversation.title,
        run=run,
        runner=runner,
        tools=tools,
        model=build_chat_model(get_settings()),
        system_prompt=assembled.system_prompt,
        model_name=run.model,
        model_input=model_input,
        started_at=run.started_at or _now(),
        started_wall=_now(),
        content_parts=content_parts,
        reasoning_parts=reasoning_parts,
        usage=usage,
        user_message_id=user_message.id,
        user_text=user_message.content,
        client_message_id=user_message.client_message_id or "",
        user_message_created=user_message.created_at,
        reasoning_effort=run.reasoning_effort or "low",
    )


def _build_graph_for(runtime: RunRuntime, saver, *, halt: bool = False):
    gate = build_halt_gate() if halt else build_approval_gate(runtime.runner)
    return build_graph(
        runtime.model,
        saver,
        system_prompt=runtime.system_prompt,
        tools=runtime.tools,
        tool_executor=runtime.runner.execute,
        approval_gate=gate,
        max_tool_rounds=get_settings().max_tool_rounds,
    )


async def _clear_stale_interrupt(saver, runtime: RunRuntime, config: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """新 run 开始前清理同一会话线程里残留的 interrupt（防御性兜底）。"""
    probe = _build_graph_for(runtime, saver, halt=True)
    snapshot = await probe.aget_state(config)
    if not snapshot.next:
        return
    logger.warning(
        "清理残留 interrupt run_id=%s thread=%s", runtime.run_id, config["configurable"]["thread_id"]
    )
    async for _ in probe.astream(
        Command(resume={"decision": "cancel"}), config, stream_mode="messages"
    ):
        pass


async def _stream_graph(
    context: RunContext,
    runtime: RunRuntime,
    graph,
    config: dict[str, Any],
    graph_input: Any,
    *,
    is_new_conversation: bool = False,
    resumed: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """执行图并持续发事件；挂起时落库部分内容并发 run.interrupted。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    publisher = context.publisher
    run_id = runtime.run_id
    started_at = runtime.started_at
    first_token_ms: int | None = runtime.first_token_ms
    content_parts = runtime.content_parts
    reasoning_parts = runtime.reasoning_parts
    reasoning_started: datetime | None = None
    usage = runtime.usage

    try:
        if resumed:
            await publisher.emit(
                "run.resumed",
                {
                    "run_id": str(run_id),
                    "conversation_id": str(runtime.conversation_id),
                    "status": "running",
                },
                event_type="run",
                title="继续运行",
            )
        else:
            if is_new_conversation:
                await publisher.emit(
                    "conversation.created",
                    {
                        "conversation_id": str(runtime.conversation_id),
                        "title": runtime.conversation_title,
                    },
                    event_type="message",
                    title="创建会话",
                )
            await publisher.emit(
                "run.started",
                {
                    "conversation_id": str(runtime.conversation_id),
                    "user_message_id": str(runtime.user_message_id),
                    "client_message_id": runtime.client_message_id,
                    "model": runtime.model_name,
                    "reasoning_effort": runtime.reasoning_effort,
                    "workflow_id": None,
                    "workflow_version": None,
                },
                event_type="request",
                title="用户请求",
                subtitle=runtime.user_text[:80],
            )
            await publisher.emit(
                "message.created",
                {
                    "message_id": str(runtime.user_message_id),
                    "role": "user",
                    "client_message_id": runtime.client_message_id,
                    "created_at": to_iso(runtime.user_message_created),
                },
                event_type="message",
                title="用户消息",
                subtitle=runtime.user_text[:80],
            )
            assistant_message_id = runtime.run.assistant_message_id
            await publisher.emit(
                "message.started",
                {
                    "message_id": str(assistant_message_id) if assistant_message_id else "",
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "started_at": to_iso(_now()),
                },
                event_type="message",
                status="running",
                title="助手消息",
            )
            for notice in runtime.runner.notices:
                await publisher.emit(
                    "notice",
                    notice,
                    event_type="notice",
                    status="warning" if notice.get("level") == "warning" else "ok",
                    title=notice.get("code") or "提示",
                    subtitle=notice.get("message") or "",
                )

        async for chunk, metadata in graph.astream(
            graph_input,
            config,
            stream_mode="messages",
        ):
            if context.cancel_requested:
                raise asyncio.CancelledError  # noqa: TRY301 - 取消信号需要冒泡到外层
            if metadata.get("langgraph_node") != "model":
                continue
            if not hasattr(chunk, "content"):
                continue

            reasoning = chunk.additional_kwargs.get("reasoning_content")
            if isinstance(reasoning, str) and reasoning:
                if reasoning_started is None:
                    reasoning_started = _now()
                reasoning_parts.append(reasoning)
                await publisher.emit(
                    "reasoning.delta",
                    {"message_id": str(runtime.run.assistant_message_id), "delta": reasoning},
                    persist=False,
                )

            text = _content_text(chunk.content)
            if text:
                if first_token_ms is None:
                    first_token_ms = elapsed_ms(started_at)
                content_parts.append(text)
                await publisher.emit(
                    "message.delta",
                    {"message_id": str(runtime.run.assistant_message_id), "delta": text},
                    persist=False,
                )
            if chunk.usage_metadata:
                usage = (
                    _add_usage(runtime.usage, dict(chunk.usage_metadata))
                    if resumed
                    else dict(chunk.usage_metadata)
                )

        snapshot = await graph.aget_state(config)
        if snapshot.next:
            await _finalize_waiting_approval(context=context, runtime=runtime)
            return
        messages = snapshot.values.get("messages", [])
        if messages:
            final_message = messages[-1]
            final_text = _content_text(getattr(final_message, "content", ""))
            if final_text and not content_parts:
                content_parts.append(final_text)
            if getattr(final_message, "usage_metadata", None) and not usage:
                usage = dict(final_message.usage_metadata)

        now = _now()
        duration_ms = elapsed_ms(started_at, now)
        notes = _usage_dict(usage)
        content = "".join(content_parts)
        assistant_message_id = runtime.run.assistant_message_id

        if snapshot.values.get("halted"):
            await asyncio.shield(
                _finalize_canceled(
                    context=context,
                    content=content,
                    usage=notes,
                    first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                    started_at=started_at,
                    reason="approval_timeout",
                )
            )
            return

        if reasoning_parts:
            await publisher.emit(
                "reasoning.done",
                {
                    "message_id": str(assistant_message_id) if assistant_message_id else "",
                    "duration_ms": elapsed_ms(reasoning_started or started_at),
                    "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
                    "summary": "".join(reasoning_parts)[:2000],
                },
                event_type="message",
                title="思考摘要",
            )

        completed = await _finalize_success(
            run_id=run_id,
            assistant_message_id=assistant_message_id,
            content=content,
            usage=notes,
            first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            finished_at=now,
            citations=context.citations,
        )
        if not completed:
            await asyncio.shield(
                _finalize_canceled(
                    context=context,
                    content=content,
                    usage=notes,
                    first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                    started_at=started_at,
                )
            )
            return
        if context.terminal_emitted:
            return
        context.terminal_emitted = True
        await publisher.emit(
            "message.done",
            {
                "conversation_id": str(runtime.conversation_id),
                "message_id": str(assistant_message_id) if assistant_message_id else "",
                "usage": notes,
                "finish_reason": "stop",
                "model": runtime.model_name,
                "first_token_ms": first_token_ms,
                "duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "active_duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "citations": context.citations,
                "artifacts": [],
                "reasoning": (
                    {
                        "duration_ms": elapsed_ms(reasoning_started or started_at),
                        "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
                        "summary": "".join(reasoning_parts)[:2000],
                    }
                    if reasoning_parts
                    else None
                ),
            },
            event_type="message",
            title="助手回复",
            subtitle=content[:80],
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            tokens=notes,
        )
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        logger.info("运行被取消 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_canceled(
                context=context,
                content="".join(content_parts),
                usage=_usage_dict(usage),
                first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                started_at=started_at,
            )
        )
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("运行失败 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_failed(
                context=context,
                content="".join(content_parts),
                usage=_usage_dict(usage),
                first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                started_at=started_at,
            )
        )


async def execute_run(context: RunContext, is_new_conversation: bool) -> None:
    """首轮执行：装配运行时、构建图并驱动事件流。"""
    run_id = context.run_id
    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
            if run is None:
                return
            if run.status != "running":
                if run.status == "canceled" and not context.terminal_emitted:
                    context.terminal_emitted = True
                    conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
                    if conversation is not None:
                        conversation.message_count += 1
                        conversation.last_message_at = _now()
                        conversation.last_message_preview = "（已取消）"
                        await db.commit()
                    await context.publisher.emit(
                        "message.done",
                        {
                            "message_id": (
                                str(run.assistant_message_id) if run.assistant_message_id else ""
                            ),
                            "usage": _usage_dict(None),
                            "finish_reason": "canceled",
                            "model": run.model,
                            "first_token_ms": None,
                            "duration_ms": 0,
                            "active_duration_ms": 0,
                            "citations": context.citations,
                            "artifacts": [],
                        },
                        event_type="message",
                        status="canceled",
                        title="已取消",
                    )
                return
            runtime = await prepare_runtime(db, run, context.publisher, context, resumed=False)

        async with open_checkpointer() as saver:
            graph = _build_graph_for(runtime, saver)
            config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(runtime.conversation_id)}}
            await _clear_stale_interrupt(saver, runtime, config)
            await _stream_graph(
                context,
                runtime,
                graph,
                config,
                {"messages": [HumanMessage(content=runtime.model_input)]},
                is_new_conversation=is_new_conversation,
            )
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        logger.info("运行被取消 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_canceled(
                context=context,
                content="",
                usage=_usage_dict(None),
                first_token_ms=None,
                started_at=_now(),
            )
        )
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("运行失败 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_failed(
                context=context,
                content="",
                usage=_usage_dict(None),
                first_token_ms=None,
                started_at=_now(),
            )
        )


async def schedule_resume(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    """调度审批恢复任务；返回是否成功调度（不等待图执行）。"""
    if registry.is_running(run_id):
        return False
    start_seq = await _event_start_seq(run_id)
    publisher = RunEventPublisher(run_id, get_session_factory(), bus, start_seq=start_seq)
    context = RunContext(run_id=run_id, publisher=publisher)
    registry.start(context, resume_after_decision(context))
    return True


async def resume_after_decision(context: RunContext) -> None:
    """审批决定后的后台恢复：抢占 interrupted→running 并续跑同一条 run。"""
    run_id = context.run_id
    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            updated = await db.execute(
                update(Run)
                .where(Run.id == run_id, Run.status == "interrupted")
                .values(status="running")
            )
            await db.commit()
            if not updated.rowcount:
                return
            run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
            if run is None:
                return
            runtime = await prepare_runtime(db, run, context.publisher, context, resumed=True)

        async with open_checkpointer() as saver:
            graph = _build_graph_for(runtime, saver)
            config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(runtime.conversation_id)}}
            snapshot = await graph.aget_state(config)
            if not snapshot.next:
                # 决定先于挂起：gate 已按 DB 状态继续，回滚抢占即可。
                async with get_session_factory()() as db:
                    await db.execute(
                        update(Run)
                        .where(Run.id == run_id, Run.status == "running")
                        .values(status="interrupted")
                    )
                    await db.commit()
                return
            await _stream_graph(
                context,
                runtime,
                graph,
                config,
                Command(resume={"decision": "resume"}),
                resumed=True,
            )
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        logger.info("恢复任务被取消 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_canceled(
                context=context,
                content="",
                usage=_usage_dict(None),
                first_token_ms=None,
                started_at=_now(),
            )
        )
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("恢复运行失败 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_failed(
                context=context,
                content="",
                usage=_usage_dict(None),
                first_token_ms=None,
                started_at=_now(),
            )
        )


async def halt_run(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    """清理 checkpoint 里残留的 interrupt；不写 run/message、不发事件。"""
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return False
        start_seq = await _event_start_seq(run_id)
        publisher = RunEventPublisher(run_id, get_session_factory(), bus, start_seq=start_seq)
        context = RunContext(run_id=run_id, publisher=publisher)
        runtime = await prepare_runtime(db, run, publisher, context, resumed=True)

    async with open_checkpointer() as saver:
        graph = _build_graph_for(runtime, saver, halt=True)
        config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(runtime.conversation_id)}}
        snapshot = await graph.aget_state(config)
        if not snapshot.next:
            return False
        async for _ in graph.astream(
            Command(resume={"decision": "cancel"}), config, stream_mode="messages"
        ):
            pass
    return True


async def _finalize_waiting_approval(
    *,
    context: RunContext,
    runtime: RunRuntime,
) -> None:
    """图停在审批 gate：落库部分内容、run→interrupted、发非终态 run.interrupted。"""
    now = _now()
    duration_ms = elapsed_ms(runtime.started_at, now)
    content = "".join(runtime.content_parts)
    usage = _usage_dict(runtime.usage)
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, runtime.run_id)
        if run is None:
            return
        assistant = (
            await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id) if run.assistant_message_id else None
        )
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "streaming"
            assistant.citations = context.citations
        run.status = "interrupted"
        run.duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.first_token_ms = runtime.first_token_ms
        run.input_tokens = usage["input_tokens"]
        run.output_tokens = usage["output_tokens"]
        run.reasoning_tokens = usage["reasoning_tokens"]
        conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
        if conversation is not None:
            conversation.last_message_at = now
            conversation.last_message_preview = content[:80] or "（等待审批）"
        approval_ids = list(
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(Approval.id).where(
                        Approval.run_id == run.id, Approval.status == "pending"
                    )
                )
            ).scalars()
        )
        await db.commit()
        assistant_message_id = run.assistant_message_id

    await context.publisher.emit(
        "run.interrupted",
        {
            "run_id": str(runtime.run_id),
            "message_id": str(assistant_message_id) if assistant_message_id else "",
            "status": "interrupted",
            "approvals": [str(item) for item in approval_ids],
            "usage": usage,
            "citations": context.citations,
        },
        event_type="run",
        status="interrupted",
        title="等待人工确认",
        duration_ms=duration_ms,
    )

结果出来了（job 实际完成，pytest 61 秒，可能是超时 30s ×2 个测试）。2 failed, 1 passed。

失败原因需要看详细。可能是 `collect_run_events_live` 30s timeout（Approval 决定后没有 message.done）。日志显示决定 200 OK。为什么恢复没完成？

分析 test_approval_duplicate_decision_409：
- 第一次决定 reject → 200 (resumed?)。第二次决定 approve → 409（正确？）。
- 事件流等 message.done 超时。

可能：resume 任务没有被调度（决定先于挂起，resume_error="运行尚未进入等待审批状态"），但 gate 复查 DB 时……问题：gate 在 `_ensure_approval` 中 emit approval.required **之后**，回调里决定接口查询 run.status。此时 run.status 是什么？execute_run 中 run 是 running（数据库）。回调决定接口：remaining pending = 0（刚决定），run.status == "running" → else 分支→ resume_error（不调度）。然后 gate 继续 `_load_approvals`（同一个 db session，读到自己 committed 的状态？decide 用另一个 session committed，gate 的 session 在事务中？gate 的 db session 之前 `_ensure_approval` commit 过，之后 select 会看到新事务的快照吗？SQLAlchemy async session 在 commit 后新查询开启新事务，应该看到已提交数据）。
- gate 看到 approvals 全部 rejected → return {} → tools 执行（rejected）→ model 第二步 "收尾" → `_stream_graph` 完成 → `_finalize_success` → emit message.done。应该 200ms 内完成。
- 除非：gate 的 `_load_approvals` 在 emit 之前查询？顺序：`_ensure_approval`（emit 在其中）→ 回调决定（同步 HTTP 请求，await 完成）→ 回到 gate → `_load_approvals`。应该看到 rejected。

但日志中第二次决定 409 说明第一次决定成功。测试卡 30s 等 message.done。

另一个可能：`interrupt()` 在 gate 里已经调用（回调决定时 gate 还没执行到 interrupt? 回调在 emit 中 await，HTTP 请求返回后 gate 继续，看到 rejected，不调用 interrupt）。除非 SQLAlchemy 的 REPEATABLE READ 隔离级别导致 gate 的 session 看到旧数据？默认 READ COMMITTED，每语句新快照。应该看到。

或者：测试的 `collect_run_events_live` 在 `on_event` 回调里发请求。这是一个 SSE 生成器任务；决定请求走 ASGI 传输，在同一 event loop。HITL 的 gate 在后台任务（asyncio task）。回调里 `await client.post(...)` 会 yield 控制权，后台任务的 gate 继续执行？gate 的 emit 是 `await publisher.emit(...)`，在 emit 内部 publish 到 bus，然后返回。collect 的 on_event 在 SSE 读取侧，收到事件后发决定。gate 尚未返回 emit。决定 HTTP 请求被处理（ASGI 任务），然后返回。gate 继续。

也许问题在 `_get_run` 的 run.status：execute_run 把 run 状态写为 running（start_chat 创建时就是 running）。决定接口 remaining pending=0、run.status=running → 不调度。OK。

那为什么没完成？看完整失败输出。重新跑单个测试，用 `-x -s --timeout`? pytest 没装 timeout 插件。用 `timeout 60` + `-v` 看断言。

其实可以查看测试失败在哪一行。跑 `test_approval_list_stats_and_filters` 单独带 -v，等待。先分析可能更快的路径：检查后台任务是否异常。日志里应有 "运行失败" 的 exception。上面输出只显示最后几行。重新跑单个测试并把输出保存到文件，tail 足够多。

另外可能：`_stream_graph` 里 `for notice in runtime.notices` —— assembled.notices 是 list[dict]；OK。

或者 `graph.astream` 在恢复后 gate 返回 {} → 条件边 route_after_gate 读 `state.get("halted")`：model 节点返回 halted=False → OK。

另一个大问题：`_finalize_success` 的 `assistant_message_id` 是 UUID；`_stream_graph` 传入 `runtime.run.assistant_message_id`——run 是从 DB session 读取的 ORM 对象，session 关闭后属性仍可用（未过期？commit 后 expire_on_commit 可能让属性过期，session 关闭后访问会 DetachedInstanceError！）。prepare_runtime 中最后 `db.commit()`（attachment_snapshot 时）会 expire run 属性；之后访问 runtime.run.assistant_message_id 在 session 关闭后可能失败。但日志没显示异常……实际上我们传到 RunRuntime 的 `run=run`，随后用 runtime.run.assistant_message_id。如果 commit 后 expire，访问需要 refresh → DetachedInstanceError。这会导致后台任务异常（被 except 捕获 → _finalize_failed → emit error 终态），事件流会收到 error 并停止（stop_on 包含 error）。测试断言 events[-1][0] == "message.done" 会失败，不是超时。

但我把 `assistant_message_id` 提前放进 runtime 更安全。RunRuntime 需要 assistant_message_id 字段。改。

先看具体失败信息。跑单个测试输出到文件。

        exc_tb: Optional[TracebackType],

没有运行失败/审批日志。说明后台任务根本没有产生任何事件？也许 execute_run 卡住了：`_stream_graph` 的 astream 一直没结束？

整个流程：start_chat 创建 run，registry.start(execute_run)。测试 `_start_run` 用 service.start_chat（在测试任务里），然后 collect_run_events_live 读事件。事件流应该立刻收到 conversation.created 等。回调收到 approval.required 后决定。然后……事件流没有 message.done，30s 超时。

可能 gate 的 `interrupt()` 挂起后，astream 正常结束 → `_finalize_waiting_approval` 发 run.interrupted；恢复任务没被调度（决定先于挂起 → 不调度），但 gate 在 interrupt 前复查时看到的是什么？如果看到 pending（决定还没提交？不可能，决定 HTTP 已返回 200）……

等等：决定先于挂起的时序：
1. gate `_ensure_approval` 创建 pending，emit approval.required。
2. collect 读事件 → on_event 发 POST decision（await）。
3. decide 处理：写 approved/rejected，commit；然后查询 pending → 0；run.status == "running"（因为图还没挂起）→ 走 else 分支：resume_error="运行尚未进入等待审批状态，决定已记录"，不调度 resume。
4. HTTP 200 返回，on_event 返回，collect 继续读事件。
5. gate 的 emit 返回，回到 `_ensure_approval` → 循环结束 → `_load_approvals` → 应该看到 rejected/approved。
6. gate return {} → tools 执行 → model 第二段 → done。

除非第 5 步 gate 的 DB session 看不到决定（事务快照）。gate 的 session 在 `_ensure_approval` 中 `await db.commit()` 后，session 处于无事务状态；`_load_approvals` 会开启新事务读。决定在另一个 session 已提交，应该可见。

但注意：decide 的 `await db.commit()` 后查询 remaining pending，然后 `run = await db.get(Run, ...)`。没问题。

另一个可能的坑：`decide` 返回后，gate 的 `interrupt()` 被调用了吗？如果 `_load_approvals` 返回的 approvals 是 **旧对象**（session identity map 中的 Approval，status 属性未刷新）！`_load_approvals` 用 `select(Approval).where(...)` 查询，SQLAlchemy identity map 会返回同一 session 中已存在的 Approval 对象（`_ensure_approval` 中创建的 approval），其 status 属性是 "pending"（创建时的对象），即使数据库已被 decide 更新，除非 refresh。SQLAlchemy 查询默认会用数据库行填充属性？在 identity map 命中时，默认 **不会覆盖已有对象的属性**（除非 populate_existing / expired）。commit 后对象过期（expire_on_commit=True 默认），访问 status 会触发 refresh → 应该看到新值！但 `_ensure_approval` 中 `await db.refresh(approval)` 刷新为 pending；随后 commit？没有。`_load_approvals` 在同一 session 中返回 identity map 对象；该对象在 emit 期间未被访问。emit 发生在 refresh 后。decide 更新 DB 后，gate 的 session 对象 status 仍是 pending（未过期，因为 create 后 refresh，无 commit 后）。

所以 `approvals` 列表中的对象 status 是 "pending" → gate 调用 `interrupt()` 挂起！此时 astream 结束，`_finalize_waiting_approval` 发 run.interrupted；由于决定先到、没有调度 resume → run 永远 interrupted。这正是卡住的原因。

修复：gate 在 `_load_approvals` 时强制从 DB 读取最新值：使用 `select(Approval).where(...).execution_options(populate_existing=True)`，或 `await db.refresh(approval)` 对每个，或 `db.expire_all()`。用 `populate_existing()` 最简单：
```python
select(Approval).where(...).execution_options(populate_existing=True)
```
另外恢复轮次（interrupt 后 resume）也需要最新状态。同样加。

另外 `Run` 对象在 gate 中查 `db.get(Run)` 可能是 identity map 旧对象；run.status 一般不变（除非 cancel）。resume 时 run 状态由 resume 任务更新为 running，gate 重建 session 新查询，OK。但同一 session 中 `_cancel_run_approvals` 后查询对象同问题——用 populate_existing。

修改 approvals.py 的 `_find_approval`、`_load_approvals` 加 populate_existing。

另外还要注意 tools.py 的 `_approval_guard` 查询也应在 fresh session（它用新 session，OK）。

修复后重跑。

另外 `_ensure_approval` 中 `await db.refresh(approval)` 之后 emit，同一 session 对象 status=pending；决定后 `_load_approvals` populate_existing 会刷新。

改。
找到根因：gate 的 ORM 对象在 identity map 里仍是 `pending`，决定已提交但 `_load_approvals` 读到旧状态，导致错误挂起。加 `populate_existing` 强制刷新。

gate 看到的审批仍为 pending！populate_existing 没有生效，说明 DB 里 status 还是 pending？decide 接口返回 200 并 commit 了 approved。但 gate 查询在同一 session 中看到 pending。

可能原因：decide 的 commit 在 gate 的 session 事务快照内不可见？SQLAlchemy AsyncSession 在 `_ensure_approval` 中 commit 后，`_load_approvals` 开始新事务。但 gate 的 `_load_approvals` 查询发生在 `_ensure_approval` 的 emit 返回之后——而 emit 的回调 HTTP 请求是在 **SSE 消费任务的 on_event** 中执行的。注意：on_event 是在 `collect_run_events_live` 的循环里 await client.post(...)。这个 POST 由 ASGI 处理；处理完成后返回。在这期间 gate 后台任务是否继续？gate 的 `await publisher.emit(...)` 在 publish 后返回；publish 将事件放入 queue（不等待消费者）。所以 emit 返回后 gate 立即继续查询，可能在 decide HTTP 完成**之前**！时序：
1. gate emit → bus.publish（put_nowait）→ emit 返回
2. gate 继续 `_load_approvals`（此时决定 HTTP 还没处理）
3. SSE 消费任务收到事件 → await on_event → POST decide → 处理
4. gate 已经看到 pending → interrupt 挂起
5. decide 处理时 run.status：此时 run 是 running（execute_run 还在 gate），remaining pending=0，run.status=running → 不调度 resume
6. gate 挂起 → run.interrupted → 死等。

这正是"决定先于挂起"的竞态，而 gate 的"interrupt 前复查"无法覆盖，因为复查发生在决定提交之前。

解决方案：决定接口在看到 run.status == "running"（尚未挂起）时也要调度一次恢复/或延迟重试，让 gate 挂起后能恢复。或者 gate 在调用 interrupt 前等待一个事件循环 tick（让决定先完成）——不可靠。

更稳妥：decide 时若 run.status == "running"（未挂起），**安排一次延迟 resume 尝试**（等 gate 挂起后）。但 resume 任务可能在 gate 挂起前检查 snapshot（next 为空 → 回滚）→ 失败。

设计改进（Q1 审查建议）：decide 的 resume 任务先等待旧任务结束（或等待 run 进入 interrupted）再检查 checkpoint。这样即使决定先到，resume 任务会等 execute_run 任务结束（gate 挂起后 execute_run 结束），然后 resume。实现：
- `schedule_resume` 在 registry 中获取旧 context 的 task，等待它结束（带超时 10s），然后执行 resume。
- 但 decide 的响应不能等待；调度后台任务即可。
- decide 判断：无论 run.status 是 running 还是 interrupted，只要没结束就调度 resume（run.status running 时也调度）。resume 任务：
  - 等待旧任务（registry.get(run_id).task）结束；若旧任务不存在（已结束），直接继续。
  - 然后条件更新 interrupted→running；若 run 还是 running（旧任务已结束但状态 running？execute_run 结束时若挂起会写 interrupted；所以旧任务结束后状态应为 interrupted）；若状态不是 interrupted（如 succeeded）→ 退出。
  - 检查 checkpoint next 空 → 回滚/退出。
- 若 gate 已挂起且 execute_run 任务已结束，resume 正常。

但 wait 旧任务的引用：`registry.get(run_id)` 返回 context（含 task）。注意 registry 的 done callback 会在任务结束后移除 context，可能拿不到 task。在 decide 时立即获取 context.task 引用，然后后台任务等待它。实现 `schedule_resume`：
```python
async def schedule_resume(run_id):
    existing = registry.get(run_id)
    wait_task = existing.task if existing and existing.task is not None and not existing.task.done() else None
    ...create context & task...
```
resume_after_decision 首先 `if wait_task: await asyncio.wait([wait_task], timeout=10)`。但 wait_task 可能是当前任务本身？不是（旧 execute_run）。注意 `resume_after_decision` 自己的任务也被 registry.start 注册，`registry.start` 会覆盖同 run 的 context（旧 context 若还在）。覆盖后旧 task 的 done callback 会 `pop(run_id)`，把新的 context 也删掉！registry.start 的 done callback 用 lambda pop(run_id)，会误删新 context。需要处理：在 schedule_resume 中，如果旧任务还在跑，先不覆盖 registry 的 context（用 `asyncio.create_task` 而非 registry.start；等旧任务结束后注册新 context）。或者修改 registry.start 的 done callback：`self._contexts.pop(context.run_id, None)` 仅在当前 context 是自己时才 pop。

修改 registry.start：
```python
def _cleanup(ctx):
    if self._contexts.get(ctx.run_id) is ctx:
        self._contexts.pop(ctx.run_id, None)
context.task.add_done_callback(lambda _: _cleanup(context))
```
这样并发安全。

schedule_resume 流程（异步）：
```python
async def schedule_resume(run_id):
    existing = registry.get(run_id)
    wait_task = existing.task if existing and existing.task and not existing.task.done() else None
    start_seq = await _event_start_seq(run_id)
    publisher = ...
    context = RunContext(...)
    registry.start(context, _resume_after_wait(context, wait_task))
    return True
```
registry.start 覆盖 context（旧 context 被替换；旧 task 仍在跑）。旧 task done callback 检查 current is old → 不删新 context。好。

`_resume_after_wait(context, wait_task)`:
```python
async def _resume_after_wait(context, wait_task):
    if wait_task is not None:
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(wait_task), timeout=10)
        except (TimeoutError, asyncio.CancelledError):
            pass
    await resume_after_decision(context)
```
注意 asyncio.wait_for + shield：wait_task 是旧任务，不应该被取消。`asyncio.wait([wait_task], timeout=10)` 更好（不取消）。

decide 修改：run.status == "running" 也调度：
```python
elif run.status in {"running", "interrupted"}:
    remaining... if 0 → schedule_resume
else: error
```
但若 run.status running 且 gate 根本不会挂起（决定先到，gate 复查后继续）→ 旧任务完成后 run=succeeded；resume 任务等待旧任务结束 → 条件更新 interrupted→running 影响 0 行 → 退出。安全。

另外 resume 任务等待 10s：旧任务执行完成（gate 挂起 → execute_run 结束）通常在毫秒级。

这个方案也满足审查 Q1 的"resume 入口等待旧任务结束/等待 run 变 interrupted"。

实现改动：
1. registry.start 的 done callback 修正。
2. chat/service：schedule_resume 传 wait_task；新增 `_resume_after_wait`。
3. approvals/service：running 状态也调度。

同时删除临时 warning 日志（改为 debug）。

还有一个问题：decide 的 remaining 查询在 decide 的 session 中；它看到 0（刚更新）。OK。

另一个潜在问题：resume 的 `_finalize_canceled` 使用 `_now()` 作为 started_at（不好），但不影响。

实现。
时序问题确认：`emit` 返回后 gate 立即查库时决定 HTTP 尚未提交，gate 挂起后没人恢复。按 spec 的「决定先于挂起」方案补上「resume 等待旧任务结束」。

from pathlib import Path

# 1) registry: 并发 context 下只清理自己
p = Path("app/modules/chat/registry.py")
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(
    """    def start(self, context: RunContext, coroutine) -> None:
        context.task = asyncio.create_task(coroutine, name=f"run-{context.run_id}")
        self._contexts[context.run_id] = context
        context.task.add_done_callback(lambda _: self._contexts.pop(context.run_id, None))
""",
    """    def start(self, context: RunContext, coroutine) -> None:
        context.task = asyncio.create_task(coroutine, name=f"run-{context.run_id}")
        self._contexts[context.run_id] = context

        def _cleanup(_: asyncio.Task) -> None:
            # 同一 run 可能先有首轮任务、后有恢复任务：只清理自己，避免误删新 context。
            if self._contexts.get(context.run_id) is context:
                self._contexts.pop(context.run_id, None)

        context.task.add_done_callback(_cleanup)
""",
)
p.write_text(s)

# 2) service: schedule_resume 等旧任务；新增 _resume_after_wait
p = Path("app/modules/chat/service.py")
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(
    '''async def schedule_resume(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    """调度审批恢复任务；返回是否成功调度（不等待图执行）。"""
    if registry.is_running(run_id):
        return False
    start_seq = await _event_start_seq(run_id)
    publisher = RunEventPublisher(run_id, get_session_factory(), bus, start_seq=start_seq)
    context = RunContext(run_id=run_id, publisher=publisher)
    registry.start(context, resume_after_decision(context))
    return True
''',
    '''async def schedule_resume(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    """调度审批恢复任务；返回是否成功调度（不等待图执行）。

    决定可能先于图挂起到达：等待旧 execute_run 任务收尾后再检查 checkpoint，
    避免「决定已落库但没有任务负责恢复」的竞态。
    """
    existing = registry.get(run_id)
    wait_task = (
        existing.task
        if existing is not None and existing.task is not None and not existing.task.done()
        else None
    )
    start_seq = await _event_start_seq(run_id)
    publisher = RunEventPublisher(run_id, get_session_factory(), bus, start_seq=start_seq)
    context = RunContext(run_id=run_id, publisher=publisher)
    registry.start(context, _resume_after_wait(context, wait_task))
    return True


async def _resume_after_wait(
    context: RunContext, wait_task: asyncio.Task | None
) -> None:
    """等待首轮任务结束（gate 挂起后 execute_run 返回），再走恢复。"""
    if wait_task is not None:
        await asyncio.wait({wait_task}, timeout=10)
    await resume_after_decision(context)
''',
)
p.write_text(s)

# 3) approvals: running 状态也调度（决定先到）
p = Path("app/modules/approvals/service.py")
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(
    '''        if remaining:
            # 一轮多审批：等全部决定完再恢复（gate 只调用一次 interrupt）。
            resume_error = "本轮还有其他审批待处理"
        elif run.status == "interrupted":
            from app.modules.chat import service as chat_service

            resumed = await chat_service.schedule_resume(approval.run_id)
            if not resumed:
                resume_error = "运行不在等待审批状态或已有恢复任务"
        else:
            resume_error = "运行尚未进入等待审批状态，决定已记录"
''',
    '''        if remaining:
            # 一轮多审批：等全部决定完再恢复（gate 只调用一次 interrupt）。
            resume_error = "本轮还有其他审批待处理"
        elif run.status in {"running", "interrupted"}:
            # running 表示决定先于图挂起到达；恢复任务会先等首轮任务收尾。
            from app.modules.chat import service as chat_service

            resumed = await chat_service.schedule_resume(approval.run_id)
            if not resumed:
                resume_error = "运行不在等待审批状态或已有恢复任务"
        else:
            resume_error = "运行状态不支持恢复"
''',
)
p.write_text(s)

# 4) gate 临时日志降级
p = Path("app/modules/chat/approvals.py")
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('        logger.warning(\n            "gate 状态 run_id=%s approvals=%s",', '        logger.debug(\n            "gate 状态 run_id=%s approvals=%s",')
p.write_text(s)
print("patched")
EOF

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid

import httpx
from sqlalchemy import select

from app.db.models.approval import Approval
from app.db.models.chat import Run
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.db.session import get_session_factory
from app.modules.chat import service as chat_service
from app.modules.chat.schemas import ChatStreamRequest
from app.modules.chat.service import start_chat
from app.modules.mcp.service import register_test_transport
from tests.conftest import auth_headers, collect_run_events_live, register_user
from tests.helpers import MOCK_TOOL_WRITE, make_mcp_transport, make_scripted_model

MOCK_URL = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"


async def _setup(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch, *, first_text: str = ""
) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict]:
    """带写工具（需审批）的 MCP 服务器；脚本模型第一步调用写工具。"""
    calls: dict[str, int] = {"tools_call": 0}
    transport = make_mcp_transport([MOCK_TOOL_WRITE])
    original_handle = transport.handle_async_request

    async def counting_handle(request):
        calls["tools_call"] += 1
        return await original_handle(request)

    from httpx import MockTransport

    counting = MockTransport(counting_handle)
    register_test_transport(MOCK_URL, counting)
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/mcp/servers",
        json={"name": "测试", "slug": "test-mcp", "transport": "streamable_http", "url": MOCK_URL},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert created.status_code == 201
    step: dict = {"tool_calls": [{"name": "mcp__test-mcp__create_issue", "args": {"title": "x"}}]}
    if first_text:
        step["text"] = first_text
    model = make_scripted_model([step, {"text": "收尾"}])
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat_service, "build_chat_model", lambda settings: model)
    return registered, headers, calls


async def _start_run(registered: dict, message: str):
    async with get_session_factory()() as session:
        user = await session.scalar(
            select(User).where(User.id == uuid.UUID(registered["user"]["id"]))
        )
        assert user is not None
        return await start_chat(session, user, ChatStreamRequest(message=message))


async def _decide(client, headers, approval_id: str, decision: str) -> httpx.Response:
    return await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/approvals/{approval_id}/decision",
        json={"decision": decision},
        headers=headers,
    )


async def _wait_terminal(run_id: str, timeout: float = 30.0) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    return await collect_run_events_live(run_id, timeout=timeout)


async def test_interrupt_then_approve_resumes_and_executes_once(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch
) -> None:
    registered, headers, calls = await _setup(client, monkeypatch)
    result = await _start_run(registered, "创建工单")
    approvals: list[str] = []

    async def on_event(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
        if name == "run.interrupted":
            assert data["status"] == "interrupted"
            approvals.extend(data["approvals"])
            response = await _decide(client, headers, data["approvals"][0], "approve")
            assert response.status_code == 200
            assert response.json()["resumed"] is True

    events = await _wait_terminal(str(result.run_id), on_event=on_event)
    names = [name for name, _ in events]
    assert "run.interrupted" in names
    assert names[-1] == "message.done"
    assert events[-1][1]["finish_reason"] == "stop"
    assert approvals
    # 工具只执行一次（审批通过后），且整轮成功
    assert calls["tools_call"] >= 1
    async with get_session_factory()() as session:
        run = await session.get(Run, result.run_id)
        assert run is not None and run.status == "succeeded"
        approval = await session.scalar(select(Approval).where(Approval.run_id == result.run_id))
        assert approval is not None and approval.status == "approved"
        assert approval.tool_call_id


async def test_interrupt_then_reject_does_not_execute(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch
) -> None:
    registered, headers, calls = await _setup(client, monkeypatch)
    result = await _start_run(registered, "创建工单")
    calls_before = calls["tools_call"]

    async def on_event(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
        if name == "run.interrupted":
            response = await _decide(client, headers, data["approvals"][0], "reject")
            assert response.status_code == 200

    events = await _wait_terminal(str(result.run_id), on_event=on_event)
    assert events[-1][0] == "message.done"
    assert events[-1][1]["finish_reason"] == "stop"
    rejected = [data for name, data in events if name == "tool.result" and data["status"] == "rejected"]
    assert rejected, "拒绝后应产生 rejected 的 tool.result"
    assert calls["tools_call"] == calls_before, "拒绝后不应真正调用 MCP 工具"


async def test_decision_before_suspend_still_completes(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch
) -> None:
    registered, headers, _ = await _setup(client, monkeypatch)
    result = await _start_run(registered, "创建工单")
    decided = False

    async def on_event(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
        nonlocal decided
        if name == "approval.required" and not decided:
            decided = True
            response = await _decide(client, headers, data["approval_id"], "approve")
            assert response.status_code == 200

    events = await _wait_terminal(str(result.run_id), on_event=on_event)
    assert events[-1][0] == "message.done"
    assert events[-1][1]["finish_reason"] == "stop"
    async with get_session_factory()() as session:
        rows = list(
            (
                await session.execute(
                    select(Approval).where(Approval.run_id == result.run_id)
                )
            ).scalars()
        )
        assert len(rows) == 1
        assert rows[0].status == "approved"


async def test_interrupted_run_persists_partial_content(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch
) -> None:
    registered, headers, _ = await _setup(client, monkeypatch, first_text="先思考一下")
    result = await _start_run(registered, "创建工单")
    interrupted: dict = {}

    async def on_event(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
        if name == "run.interrupted":
            interrupted.update(data)

    events = await collect_run_events_live(
        str(result.run_id), stop_on={"run.interrupted", "error"}, on_event=on_event
    )
    assert events[-1][0] == "run.interrupted"
    assert interrupted["approvals"]
    async with get_session_factory()() as session:
        run = await session.get(Run, result.run_id)
        assert run is not None and run.status == "interrupted"
        message = await session.get(
            __import__("app.db.models.conversation", fromlist=["Message"]).Message,
            run.assistant_message_id,
        )
        assert message is not None
        assert message.status == "streaming"
        assert "先思考" in message.content
    # 清理挂起状态，避免影响后续用例
    await chat_service.halt_run(result.run_id)

MOCK_URL = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"


async def _setup(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch, *, first_text: str = ""

    """带写工具（需审批）的 MCP 服务器；脚本模型第一步调用写工具。"""
    calls: dict[str, int] = {"tools_call": 0}
    transport = make_mcp_transport([MOCK_TOOL_WRITE])
    original_handle = transport.handle_async_request

    async def counting_handle(request):
        calls["tools_call"] += 1
        return await original_handle(request)

    from httpx import MockTransport

    counting = MockTransport(counting_handle)
    register_test_transport(MOCK_URL, counting)
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/mcp/servers",
        json={"name": "测试", "slug": "test-mcp", "transport": "streamable_http", "url": MOCK_URL},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert created.status_code == 201
    step: dict = {"tool_calls": [{"name": "mcp__test-mcp__create_issue", "args": {"title": "x"}}]}
    if first_text:

    model = make_scripted_model([step, {"text": "收尾"}])

    async with get_session_factory()() as session:

        )
        assert user is not None
        return await start_chat(session, user, ChatStreamRequest(message=message))


async def _decide(client, headers, approval_id: str, decision: str) -> httpx.Response:
    return await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/approvals/{approval_id}/decision",
        json={"decision": decision},
        headers=headers,
    )


async def _wait_terminal(run_id: str, timeout: float = 30.0) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    return await collect_run_events_live(run_id, timeout=timeout)


async def test_interrupt_then_approve_resumes_and_executes_once(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch
) -> None:
    registered, headers, calls = await _setup(client, monkeypatch)
    result = await _start_run(registered, "创建工单")
    approvals: list[str] = []

    async def on_event(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
        if name == "run.interrupted":
            assert data["status"] == "interrupted"
            approvals.extend(data["approvals"])

            assert response.status_code == 200

    events = await _wait_terminal(str(result.run_id), on_event=on_event)

Task 7 的 4 个集成测试全部通过！核心迁移成功。

现在 Task 8：
- 审批超时 → expired + run canceled（sweeper）
- 取消 interrupted run → 终态 + halt
- 多审批逐条决定（resumed=false 中间态）
- 取消后会话可继续
- 更新 expire_pending

实现：

`approvals/service.py`：
1. `expire_pending(limit=200) -> list[uuid.UUID]`：
   现状只置 expired 并返回数量。改为：
   ```python
   async def expire_pending(limit=200) -> list[uuid.UUID]:
       now = _now()
       canceled_runs: list[uuid.UUID] = []
       async with get_session_factory()() as db:
           rows = list((await db.execute(select(Approval).where(pending, expires_at <= now).limit(limit).with_for_update(skip_locked=True))).scalars())
           if not rows: return []
           run_ids = {row.run_id for row in rows}
           for row in rows: row.status = "expired"
           await db.commit()  # 先置 expired
           for run_id in run_ids:
               # 该 run 是否还有其他 pending？
               remaining = await db.scalar(select(func.count(Approval.id)).where(Approval.run_id==run_id, Approval.status=="pending"))
               if remaining: continue
               # 抢占 run 状态
               updated = await db.execute(update(Run).where(Run.id==run_id, Run.status=="interrupted").values(status="canceled", canceled_at=now, finished_at=now))
               await db.commit()
               if not updated.rowcount: continue
               # 写 assistant canceled + 计数 + 审计
               run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
               ...
               canceled_runs.append(run_id)
               # 调度 halt + 发终态事件（在 db 会话外）
       for run_id in canceled_runs:
           await chat_service.halt_run(run_id)  # 后台？sweeper 顺序 await，每条最坏几十 ms
           await _emit_timeout_event(run_id)
       return canceled_runs
   ```
   但 `with_for_update(skip_locked=True)` 与后续 commit 可能复杂。简化：select ids，然后逐条 UPDATE approvals SET status=expired WHERE id IN (...) AND status='pending'。然后处理 run。
   
   终态事件：需要 publisher。写 helper `_finalize_timeout(run_id, publisher?)`：
   ```python
   from app.modules.chat.events import RunEventPublisher
   from app.modules.chat.bus import bus
   async def _cancel_run_for_timeout(run_id) -> bool:
       # 条件更新 interrupted→canceled 已在上面完成；这里写 assistant、计数、发 message.done
   ```
   为避免循环导入，在 approvals/service 内 import chat.service 的函数。chat 侧更适合实现 `cancel_interrupted_run(run_id, reason)`。放在 chat/service.py：
   ```python
   async def cancel_interrupted_run(run_id: uuid.UUID, *, reason: str = "approval_timeout") -> bool:
       """取消等待审批的 run：抢占状态、写终态、调度 halt、发 message.done。"""
       async with get_session_factory()() as db:
           updated = await db.execute(update(Run).where(Run.id==run_id, Run.status=="interrupted").values(status="canceled", canceled_at=_now(), finished_at=_now()))
           await db.commit()
           if not updated.rowcount: return False
           run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
           if run is None: return False
           assistant = await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id) if ... else None
           if assistant is not None:
               assistant.status = "canceled"
               # content 保留已落库内容
           conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
           if conversation: message_count += 1; last_message_at; preview
           # 清理 pending 审批
           await db.execute(update(Approval).where(Approval.run_id==run_id, Approval.status.in_(("pending","approved"))).values(status="canceled"))
           await db.commit()
           content = assistant.content if assistant else ""
           message_id = ...
           model_name = run.model
       publisher = RunEventPublisher(run_id, get_session_factory(), bus, start_seq=await _event_start_seq(run_id))
       # 幂等：若已有 message.done 事件则跳过
       if await _has_terminal_event(run_id): return True
       await publisher.emit("message.done", {...finish_reason:"canceled", reason: reason...}, ...)
       asyncio.create_task(halt_run(run_id))  # 后台清理
       return True
   ```
   `_has_terminal_event(run_id)`：查询 RunEvent where run_id and payload["_event"] in ("message.done","error")。payload JSONB 查询：`RunEvent.payload["_event"].astext.in_(...)`。简单用 `RunEvent.type`？type 是 event_type（"message"/"error"），不够。用 payload['_event'].astext == 'message.done'。
   
   注意 sweepers 的 run.status 抢占：expire_pending 先置 expired，然后调用 `cancel_interrupted_run`（它自己抢占）。不要把抢占放 expire_pending 里，避免重复。expire_pending 流程：
   1. 过期 approvals → expired（更新 + 收集 run_ids）。
   2. 对每个 run_id：若 run 仍有 pending → skip；调用 `chat_service.cancel_interrupted_run(run_id, reason="approval_timeout")`。

```python
        assistant = await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id) if run.assistant_message_id else None
        content = assistant.content if assistant else ""
        if assistant is not None:

        conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
        if conversation is not None:
            conversation.message_count += 1
            conversation.last_message_at = now
            conversation.last_message_preview = content[:80] or "（审批超时已取消）"
        await db.execute(update(Approval).where(Approval.run_id==run_id, Approval.status.in_(("pending","approved"))).values(status="canceled"))

        await db.commit()

    if not await _has_terminal_event(run_id):
```

        if name == "run.interrupted":
            approval_ids.extend(data["approvals"])

        headers=headers,
    )

    assert decision.status_code == 409
    assert decision.json()["error"]["code"] in {
        "approval_already_decided",
        "approval_expired",
    }
'''

def _apply_auth(
    agent: RemoteAgent,
    card: dict,
    auth: object | None,
) -> None:
    """把注册/更新时的 auth 输入落到 Agent；secret_ref 只存引用。"""
    if auth is None:
        return
    auth_type = getattr(auth, "type", None) or "none"
    secret_ref = (getattr(auth, "secret_ref", None) or "").strip() or None
    if auth_type == "none":
        agent.auth_type = "none"
        agent.auth_scheme = "none"
        agent.secret_ref = None
        return
    if auth_type == "oauth2":
        agent.auth_type = "oauth2"
        agent.auth_scheme = "oauth2"
        agent.secret_ref = None
        return
    # api_key：scheme 优先从 Card 推断，其次默认 bearer。
    agent.auth_type = "api_key"
    agent.auth_scheme = _infer_auth_scheme(card) if agent.auth_scheme == "none" else agent.auth_scheme
    if agent.auth_scheme in {"none", "oauth2"}:
        agent.auth_scheme = "bearer"
    agent.secret_ref = secret_ref
    if secret_ref:
        agent.auth_hint = secret_ref

```python
async def test_chat_mcp_approval_timeout_interrupts(client: httpx.AsyncClient, monkeypatch) -> None:
    """审批超时：approval→expired、run→canceled，晚决定 409。"""
    from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

    from app.db.models.approval import Approval
    from app.db.models.chat import Run
    from app.db.session import get_session_factory
    from app.modules.approvals.service import expire_pending
    from app.modules.chat import service as chat_service
    from tests.conftest import collect_run_events_live

    _register_mock([MOCK_TOOL_WRITE])
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    await _create_server(client, headers)

    model = make_scripted_model([...])
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat_service, "build_chat_model", lambda settings: model)
    # 用 service 层启动并只读到 run.interrupted（SSE 会按 D8 保持连接，不适合 collect_sse）
    from app.db.models.user import User
    from app.modules.chat.schemas import ChatStreamRequest
    from app.modules.chat.service import start_chat
    import uuid
    from sqlalchemy import select

    async def _start():
        async with get_session_factory()() as session:
            user = await session.scalar(select(User).where(User.id == uuid.UUID(registered["user"]["id"])))
            return await start_chat(session, user, ChatStreamRequest(message="创建工单"))

    result = await _start()
    interrupted = {}
    async def on_event(name, data):
        if name == "run.interrupted":
            interrupted.update(data)
    events = await collect_run_events_live(str(result.run_id), stop_on={"run.interrupted"}, on_event=on_event)
    assert interrupted["approvals"]
    approval_id = interrupted["approvals"][0]
    async with get_session_factory()() as session:
        approval = await session.get(Approval, uuid.UUID(approval_id))
        approval.expires_at = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(seconds=1)
        await session.commit()
    canceled = await expire_pending()
    assert str(result.run_id) in {str(x) for x in canceled}
    async with get_session_factory()() as session:
        run = await session.get(Run, result.run_id)
        assert run.status == "canceled"
    replay = await collect_run_events_live(str(result.run_id), timeout=10)
    assert replay[-1][0] == "message.done"
    assert replay[-1][1]["finish_reason"] == "canceled"
    assert replay[-1][1]["reason"] == "approval_timeout"
    late = await client.post(...)
    assert late.status_code == 409
    assert late.json()["error"]["code"] in {"approval_expired", "approval_already_decided"}
```

"""远程 Agent 管理 API 的请求/响应模型（字段与前端 agent.ts 对齐）。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

AgentHealthStatus = Literal["unknown", "healthy", "degraded", "unhealthy"]
AgentAuthType = Literal["none", "api_key", "oauth2"]

_SLUG_PATTERN = r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$"


class AgentAuthInput(BaseModel):
    """注册/更新时的鉴权信息；secret_ref 只存引用（如 ``env:DATA_AGENT_KEY``）。"""

    type: AgentAuthType = "none"
    secret_ref: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)

    @field_validator("secret_ref")
    @classmethod
    def _secret_ref(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return value
        value = value.strip()
        if value and not value.startswith("env:"):
            raise ValueError("secret_ref 必须为 env:环境变量名 形式")
        return value


class AgentPreviewRequest(BaseModel):
    url: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    slug: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern=_SLUG_PATTERN)
    auth: AgentAuthInput | None = None


class AgentSkillRef(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    description: str | None = None


async def create_agent(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, payload: AgentCreateRequest
) -> AgentDetailOut:
    settings = get_settings()
    # 显式 slug 时先做幂等/冲突检查，避免对冲突 URL 发起不必要的 Card 拉取。
    if payload.slug:
        existing = await db.scalar(
            select(RemoteAgent).where(
                RemoteAgent.slug == payload.slug, RemoteAgent.deleted_at.is_(None)
            )
        )
        if existing is not None:
            if existing.url == payload.url:
                return await _detail_with_recent(db, existing)
            raise ConflictError(f"slug「{payload.slug}」已被其他 Agent 使用", code="agent_slug_conflict")

    fetched = await fetch_agent_card(payload.url)
    normalized = fetched.normalized
    slug = payload.slug or _slugify(normalized["name"])

    existing = await db.scalar(
        select(RemoteAgent).where(RemoteAgent.slug == slug, RemoteAgent.deleted_at.is_(None))
    )
    if existing is not None:
        if existing.url == payload.url:
            return await _detail_with_recent(db, existing)
        raise ConflictError(
            f"slug「{slug}」已被其他 Agent 使用", code="agent_slug_conflict"
        )

    agent = RemoteAgent(
        owner_user_id=user.id,
        slug=slug,
        name=(payload.name or normalized["name"])[:128],
        description=normalized["description"][: settings.a2a_skill_description_max_chars],
        url=payload.url,
        protocol_version=normalized["protocol_version"],
        card=fetched.card,
        skills=normalized["skills"],
        capabilities=normalized["capabilities"],
        auth_type="none",
        auth_scheme="none",
        auth_hint="",
        secret_ref=None,
        headers={},
        requires_approval=_requires_approval(fetched.card),
        enabled=True,
        health_status="unknown",
        consecutive_failures=0,
        name_edited=bool(payload.name),
    )
    _apply_auth(agent, fetched.card, payload.auth)
    db.add(agent)
    await db.flush()

MCP_URL = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"


async def _register_header_capture(tools: list[dict], seen: dict) -> None:
    import json

    from httpx import MockTransport

    from app.modules.mcp.service import register_test_transport
    from tests.helpers import make_mcp_transport

    transport = make_mcp_transport(tools)
    original = transport.handle_async_request

    async def handler(request):
        try:
            payload = json.loads(request.content)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            payload = {}
        if payload.get("method") == "initialize":
            seen["authorization"] = request.headers.get("authorization")
        return await original(request)

    register_test_transport(MCP_URL, MockTransport(handler))


async def test_admin_secret_ref_resolved_for_mcp(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, admin: User, admin_auth: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    from tests.helpers import MOCK_TOOL_READ

    created_secret = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/admin/secrets",
        json={"name": "MCP_KEY", "value": "resolved-value"},
        headers=admin_auth,
    )
    assert created_secret.status_code == 201
    seen: dict = {}
    await _register_header_capture([MOCK_TOOL_READ], seen)

    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/mcp/servers",
        json={
            "name": "密钥 MCP",
            "slug": "secret-mcp",
            "transport": "streamable_http",
            "url": MCP_URL,
            "headers": {"Authorization": "secret:MCP_KEY"},
        },
        headers=admin_auth,
    )
    assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
    assert "resolved-value" not in created.text

    checked = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/mcp/servers/{created.json()['id']}/check", headers=admin_auth
    )
    assert checked.status_code == 200
    assert seen["authorization"] == "resolved-value"


async def test_normal_user_cannot_use_secret_ref(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, user: User
) -> None:
    headers = auth_headers(create_access_token(user.id).token)
    response = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/mcp/servers",
        json={
            "name": "越权 MCP",
            "slug": "bad-secret-mcp",
            "transport": "streamable_http",
            "url": MCP_URL,
            "headers": {"Authorization": "secret:MCP_KEY"},
        },
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "secret_ref_not_allowed"
EOF

assert run_id
